```lean
theorem lg_target {C : Type u₁} {D : Type u₂} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₂} D] {G : CategoryTheory.Functor D C} {F : CategoryTheory.Functor C D} (adj : F ⊣ G) (A : adj.toMonad.Algebra) : G.IsSplitPair (F.map A.a) (adj.counit.app (F.obj A.A)) := by
  constructor
  -- First, show that (adj.counit.app (F.obj A.A)) ∘ (F.map A.a) = id_(F.obj A.A)
  erw [CategoryTheory.Adjunction.comp_counit_app_assoc adj (F.obj A.A) (G.obj A.A) (A.a)]
  erw [CategoryTheory.Adjunction.unit_comp_map_eq_iff adj (F.obj A.A) (G.obj A.A) (A.a) (adj.unit.app (G.obj A.A)) (A.a)]
  rw [CategoryTheory.Adjunction.unit_app_id adj (G.obj A.A)]
  erw [CategoryTheory.Adjunction.counit_app_unit adj (F.obj A.A)]
  -- Second, show that (F.map A.a) ∘ (adj.counit.app (F.obj A.A)) = id_(G.obj A.A)
  erw [CategoryTheory.Adjunction.comp_unit_app adj (F.obj A.A) (G.obj A.A) (A.a)]
  erw [CategoryTheory.Adjunction.map_comp_unit_eq_iff adj (F.obj A.A) (G.obj A.A) (A.a) (adj.unit.app (G.obj A.A)) (A.a)]
  rw [CategoryTheory.Adjunction.unit_app_id adj (G.obj A.A)]
  erw [CategoryTheory.Adjunction.counit_app_unit adj (F.obj A.A)]
```
